39:t_1:3.en: ～ $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$, Captain's Cabin ～

39:t_1:4.en:
$$テッサ$$
「...I'm sorry, $$カナメ$$. Given the situation, the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ will continue straight on to $$翠の地球$$.」

39:t_1:5.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Don't worry about it, $$テッサ$$. If you want to get technical, it's my fault for forcing my way aboard in the first place...」

39:t_1:6.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I'm worried about $$シンジ$$ and the others, but let's leave that to everyone on the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$.」

39:t_1:8.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I'm fine. Besides, I was kind of curious about $$翠の地球$$ anyway, so it's actually pretty good timing.」

39:t_1:10.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Sorry. Was that a bit insensitive of me, at a time like this?」

39:t_1:12.en:
$$テッサ$$
「It's just... I was thinking... how strong you are, $$カナメ$$...」

39:t_1:14.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Yes. I thought so during the 《$$お台場の事件$$》 too. The way you don't lose your cheerfulness even in adversity...」

39:t_1:15.en:
$$かなめ$$
「No, $$テッサ$$. I'm not strong at all.」

39:t_1:16.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I'm sure the only reason I can laugh so carefree right now is that I don't understand how scary the $$新地球皇国$$ really is.」

39:t_1:18.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Besides, I think the reason I can stay so thick-skinned is thanks to him and everyone else.」

39:t_1:20.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Yeah. I think it's because I believe that, no matter how bad the jam, they'll somehow pull us through.」

39:t_1:21.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Not that I have any basis for it, though.」

39:t_1:22.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Then I'll have to work hard to live up to your expectations, $$カナメ$$.」

39:t_1:23.en:
$$かなめ$$
「You believe it too, right, $$テッサ$$? That $c can definitely win.」

39:t_1:24.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Of course. After all, I'm the one in command.」

39:t_1:25.en:
$$かなめ$$
「OK! Then I'll take you at your word.」

39:t_1:26.en:
$$かなめ$$
「But don't push yourself, okay? You look tired, $$テッサ$$.」

39:t_1:28.en:
$$かなめ$$
「You don't have to hide it. You've got bags under your eyes.」

39:t_1:31.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Oh, good. With a face like that, I couldn't have shown myself in front of $$相良$$.」

39:t_1:33.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I'm joking. That's payback for earlier.」

39:t_1:34.en:
$$かなめ$$
「If you can say things like that, you're still okay.」

39:t_1:35.en:
$$かなめ$$
「But seriously, don't push yourself. Please.」

39:t_1:37.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Well, I'm off to the hangar. One of the old guys from the maintenance crew seems to need me for something.」

39:t_1:38.en:
$$テッサ$$
「That would be Lieutenant $$サックス$$. I'm sure it's about $$アル$$.」

39:t_1:39.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Looks like we've still got time before we reach $$翠の地球$$, so get some good rest until then, $$テッサ$$.」

39:t_1:40.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Understood. I'll gratefully take you up on that.」

39:t_1:43.en:
$$テッサ$$
(These past three months... how many nights have I managed to sleep without a thought in my head...?)

39:t_1:44.en:
$$テッサ$$
(The $$新地球皇国$$... $$アマルガム$$... Both are powerful, and at the same time, bottomless...)

39:t_1:45.en:
$$テッサ$$
(If I keep fighting like this, a time will come when I'm forced to make an even bigger choice... When that time comes, I...)

39:t_1:47.en:
$$テッサ$$
(I should sleep now... $$カナメ$$ went out of her way to be considerate, after all...)

39:t_1:48.en:
$$テッサ$$
(When I open my eyes, there will be fighting again... Until then, let my heart rest even a little...)

39:t_1:52.en: ～ $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$, Hangar ～

39:t_1:54.en:
$$サックス$$
「Just call me $$サックス$$. I'm sure I've told you many times, $$相良$$.」

39:t_1:55.en:
$$宗介$$
「Then, Lieutenant $$サックス$$. What exactly is $$千鳥$$ doing?」

39:t_1:56.en:
$$サックス$$
「She's having a chat with that partner of yours.」

39:t_1:58.en:
$$サックス$$
「What? Did you think I, a maintenance crew guy, would tell an amateur high school girl to help out with the mechanic work?」

39:t_1:60.en:
$$サックス$$
「Well, no wonder you're surprised. It was $$アル$$ who asked for her by name.」

39:t_1:64.en:
$$サックス$$
「Then let me ask you, Sergeant. Can you tell everything I'm thinking?」

39:t_1:66.en:
$$サックス$$
「It's the same thing. What $$アル$$ is thinking, only $$アル$$ can know.」

39:t_1:67.en:
$$サックス$$
「Don't tell me you still think $$アル$$ is just an AI, at this late date?」

39:t_1:69.en:
$$サックス$$
「Exactly. If $$アル$$ wants to talk with that girl, all I'm going to do is play go-between for the date.」

39:t_1:70.en:
$$サックス$$
「Curious about $$アル$$ and that girl?」

39:t_1:72.en:
$$サックス$$
「Personally, I think a love triangle would be fun. No... add one more person, and it's a love square.」

39:t_1:74.en:
$$サックス$$
「...Sergeant... You might do well to study what the human heart is like, together with $$アル$$.」

39:t_1:75.en:
$$サックス$$
(Geez... What does our goddess see in a dense guy like this...)

39:t_1:76.en:
$$宗介$$
「I'm afraid I don't quite follow your meaning, sir...」

39:t_1:77.en:
$$サックス$$
「Never mind. If you've got nothing to do, go clean the ship with your classmates.」

39:t_1:78.en:
$$サックス$$
「Thanks to us suddenly flying out into space, this ship's a mess in every corner.」

39:t_1:80.en:
$$甲児$$
「Lieutenant $$サックス$$ is right. If you're free, come help out, $$宗介$$.」

39:t_1:81.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Yeah. Everyone with free hands is doing the cleaning, you know.」

39:t_1:83.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「I might get scolded for saying this, but... I'm a little excited. About going to $$翠の地球$$ and all.」

39:t_1:84.en:
$$正太郎$$
「You're right. After the $$時獄戦役$$, our Earth has been in total chaos, and we hardly know anything about that one.」

39:t_1:85.en:
$$アルト$$
「From its size and structure, we've confirmed it's an Earth from a parallel world, but we don't know what kind of people live there.」
